summary: The GORD rule applies the 80cm waist threshold to everyone although the page gives 94cm for men, so men with waist 80-93cm and BMI >= 25 are wrongly labelled GORD likely (c129). The allergen exposures in the anaphylaxis and urgent rules drop footnote 2's 'within the past few hours' window, and the dyspepsia/GORD rules are not gated on the page's 'No' to the gastroenteritis question. Everything else is a faithful encoding; remaining imprecisions are concept-breadth issues with no closer SNOMED concept (lumbar-only back radiation, 'aggravated by position', Constipation for 'no stools', exposure-to-organism for 'in outbreak area').
